key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in further RBA rate hikes, with housing and rate-sensitive sectors under pressure (#35)
Aussie banks forecast record house price falls; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget, signalling credit contraction (#62, #65)
Iron ore sector shows resilience: Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle; war-driven supply shakeout supports prices (#37, #68)
Global equities rallied sharply as Fed rate-hike fears eased; Nasdaq posted back-to-back gains (#45, #63)
Nvidia confirms $13B Hugging Face acquisition, reinforcing AI capex cycle; AI power demand benefits energy names (#61, #54, #71)
Construction sector under regulatory scrutiny: Bathla collapse, ASIC whistleblower review, and Worksafe re-examination raise systemic concerns (#38, #39, #21)
EV sales overtook petrol cars in Australia for first time, driven by soaring fuel costs; hidden infrastructure costs flagged (#28, #34)
RBA rate path debated: analysts urge caution before further hikes given stalling economy (#74)
ASX small-caps active: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals in focus (#25, #26, #27)

sectors.trend: Iron ore supported by war-driven supply shakeout; Macarthur WA bulk test cleared; gold (Aurum) and small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from supply-side tightening; small-cap explorers attract speculative flows but carry elevated risk

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications; banks forecast record house price declines; legal loophole criticism on customer pricing; credit contraction underway
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure from falling loan volumes; NIM compression risk if RBA pauses; credit losses may rise

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel scrutiny; energy transition costs mounting; AI data-centre power demand (Google/Entergy) supports utilities
sectors.implications: SGL.AX, WDS.AX, AGL.AX, CGP.AX benefit from gas price strength and AI-driven power demand; transition cost overhang weighs on sentiment

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging; EV adoption surging as fuel costs bite; consumer spending under pressure
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX relatively insulated; WOW.AX, WES.AX face soft consumer demand; EV transition benefits battery/charging names

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse exposes 'Ponzi economy' fragility; ASIC whistleblower review at Big Four; Worksafe re-examining Star; ratings agencies warn on Victoria debt
sectors.implications: WTC.AX, INC.AX, GPT.AX, STP.AX face reputational and regulatory overhang; housing construction to follow prices lower

sectors.trend: Nvidia $13B Hugging Face deal; AI boom 'not over'; AI power demand surging; but rising yields expose weakest AI business models (Applied Digital, Cipher)
sectors.implications: Global tech rally (Nasdaq back-to-back gains) supports sentiment; ASX tech exposure limited but AI capex benefits energy and infrastructure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hikes amid stalling economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour rate-insensitive sectors (healthcare, staples); hedge with gold

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing credit contraction and record price falls
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; favour banks with strong capital buffers; watch NAB.AX, CBA.AX credit provisions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Construction sector systemic failure (Bathla, ASIC, Worksafe)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap construction; monitor GPT.AX, STP.AX, WTC.AX for regulatory exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overhang and gas cartel risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour gas producers (SGL.AX, WDS.AX) over transition-dependent names; monitor Beetaloo outcomes

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global rate reversal / Fed policy shift
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify across geographies; US equity rally may not sustain; watch AUD/USD
Monitor policy shifts on migration, housing, energy; avoid event-driven political bets

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight iron ore and gold miners on supply-side tightening
opportunities.rationale: War-driven iron ore shakeout supports prices; Macarthur WA test cleared; Aurum gold expansion; small-cap miners showing momentum

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas and power utilities on AI-driven demand and gas price surge
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rates surge; Beetaloo cartel scrutiny may lift domestic gas prices; AI data-centre power demand structural tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Selective healthcare exposure as defensive hedge
opportunities.rationale: Ozempic disruption creates tablet alternative opportunities; CSL, SGH insulated from rate and housing cycles

defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts, 15% loan application drop, Bathla/ASIC/Worksafe systemic risks, construction to follow prices lower

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure pending credit loss visibility
defensive_moves.rationale: Loan contraction pressures NIM; legal loophole criticism on pricing; rate hike risk to asset values

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and rate risk with gold and short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hike uncertainty, stalling economy, global rate reversal risk; gold benefits from safe-haven flows

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from RBA rate-hike expectations and housing credit contraction. Global equity rally on Fed easing may provide partial offset. Construction sector regulatory overhang caps sentiment. Expect range-bound trading with sector rotation toward resources and energy.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and housing stabilises. AI capex cycle and commodity supply tightness support resources and energy. Structural headwinds from housing correction, construction fragility, and stalling GDP cap upside. Diversification across resources, healthcare, and energy preferred.
